tei:div.tei:p: (138)༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ na mo gu ru/ rtsa mdud dgrol dang rtsa srong dang*// dbu mar sdud dang rtsa 'grem bzhi'o// langs 'dren bsgyur dang stod gnon gsum// rkang gcig rkang gnyis gcu ba dang*// bu chung tshul du 'phar ba lnga// kha 'byed gnyis ni bsnol dang bgrad// dbu mar 'jug dang dbu mar 'dren// dbu mar sdud pa gsum du bzhed// rnam snang rtags bcu don yod grub// gzir dang mnyam gzhag rkang g.yab dang*// kog langs sum sprug zhes bya brgyad// rtsa la bzhi dang thig le gsum// zug ses lnga dang kha 'byed gnyis// rdo rje gar la gsum yin te// nyon mongs sel la brgyad yod kyang*// gcig tu bsdus na bco brgyad yin// dang po skyil krung ro stod lan bdun gcu// gnyis pa langs la sked gzer rting 'khrab bdun// gsum pa lag gnyis mchan khungs brla zur brkyang*// bzhi pa sar bsdad lus kun 'phur mnye bya/ lnga pa spyi bor thal spar rting pa brdab// drug pa khu tshur g.yas g.yon res mos brkyang*// bdun pa mchan khung bsdoms la ro stod gcu// brgyad dgu gnyis la dbyug mchongs byed par brgyad// 'on kyang da lta lag len de mi byed/ (139)brgyad pa pus mthil sbyar langs lag brkyang 'khrab// dgu pa rkang lag rdeg stabs rting 'khrab gsum// bcu pa sor bsnol brang 'geb lan gsum gcud// bcu gcig langs sdod mgo bo bskor lcog sprug /bcu gnyis rting 'khrab gsum mthar sa la 'bebs// bcu gsum khu tshur brang gnon gcig shos 'phul// bcu bzhi kha mig bgrad mtha' brkyang bskum sprug /bco lnga nu rdeg rgod lding sprug dang bskor// bcu drug bsnol nas 'then gnon sgyed rgu bya// bcu bdun dpung bkab sked pa lan gsum sgyog /bco brgyad pa ni nyon mongs sel ba yin// byang chub phyag rgya g.yas g.yon steng 'og gcu// srin 'dud ltag mnan ro stod g.yas g.yon gcu// don grub phyag rgyar gzhag sha brdeb pa yin// gzir ba 'bar rgya bskor zhing mig bskor bltas// mchan bung bsdams shing gtsus nas slar yang blta// mnyam gzhag rdor skyil pho ba bsdams pa dang*// rkang g.yab gan rkyal tsog zan spu'i tshul// kog langs sdigs mdzub phyogs bcu rnams su bskor// gsum sprug bsdam brkyang bshud cing sprugs pa yin// ye shes (140)mkha' 'gro ni gu'i chos drug gi

/gtum mo'i gzhung khrid 'khrul 'khor bco brgyad yin// phyi ma brgyad du phye na nyi shu lnga// ces so// de yang rlung sbyong ba zla gcig tsam song ba nas/ gtum mo'i stangs zhag bdun/ gong bu 'thabs pa zhag bdun/ dngos gzhi zhag bdun/ bla ma'i gtum mo zhag bdun/ gos su gyon pa zhag bdun bya/ de nas 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams bslabs te yang yang sbyangs pas ngal dub med cing sgrim mi dgos par song ba na/ so so'i dmigs pa rnams la thun re re byed kyin sbyangs/ mthar 'khrul 'khor tshar re la dmigs pa thams cad tshar re 'gro bar byed/ thun bzhi'am drug tu tshar re ma chags shing gtum mo la 'bad na yon tan dpag tu med pa 'phral du 'byung nges pa yin no// de la sdom tshig gi don rnams bshad par bya ste/ dang po rtsa mdud dgrol ba ni/ skyil krung lus gnad bcas la/ lag pa gnyis pus mo nas drangs te/ brla'i rtsa bar btsug /ro stod g.yas dang g.yon du gcud pa lan bdun bdun bya/ gnyis pa rtsa drang por bsrang ba ni/ lus gnad bca' gzhi gong ltar bcas/ lag pa brla'i rtsa bar slebs pa dang*/ kog gis langs la rlung 'phar byas/ lag pa rked gzer gyi ngang nas/ lto ba g.yas bskor g.yon bskor bya/ gshang sgor sdig pa re dang*/ ro stod bag tsam g.yas g.yon du gcu ba lhan cig tu bya zhing*/ de rjes rting 'khrab re dang spel ba lan bdun bya/ 'dis rtsa 'khrugs pa sel bas/ skra shad kyis skra gad byed pa dang 'dra'o// gsum pa dbu mar sdud pa ni/ snga ma'i 'phros la yin na/ rlung 'khrab cig byas pas chog /logs su byed na/ bca' gzhi gnyis pa dang 'dra bar bya/ lag pa khu tshur bcangs pa brla'i phyi 'phod tshos phyogs la brkyang zhing shed bcug la rting 'khrab gnyis gnyis kyi mtshams su/ 'phar rdeb re bya/ de 'dra lan bdun no// bzhi pa rtsa 'grem ni/ rlung bsgyur zhig byas nas (141)dang por mgo dang*/ de nas ro stod/ de rjes lag pa/

rjes su smad dang*/ rkang pa brkyang ba la 'phur mnye bya/ khyad par lag pa dang rkang pa'i nywa bzhi rnams la/ phan tshun du bshud pa dang*/ rdung bar byed/ bzhi po de rnams rtsa dag par byed/ lnga pa langs te 'grems pa ni/ bca' gzhi gnyis pa dang 'dra ba las/ lag pa rim pas rtsibs logs brgyud yar brkyang*/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ sked pa nyag gis btang*/ mthur sel mthur du bsdig pa dang*/ srog steng du drang*/ lkog mas ol mdud drag tu mnan cing*/ 'phar rdeb byed pa las/ rting pa brdeb pa shugs che bar bya/ 'di yang lan bdun bya'o// drug pa bsgyur ba ni/ bca' gzhi gong bzhin byas la/ lag gnyis khu tshur brla'i zur la brkyang*/ lus g.yon du gcud nas/ rkang lag g.yas pa drag tu brkyang bskum bya/ yan lag dang lhan cig sor mo yang brkyang bskum bya/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang bskyar/ bdun pa stod gnon ni/ bca' gzhi sngar bzhin las/ lag gnyis kyi sor mo rnams bsnol te brang la bkab/ mthe bos mchan khung logs nas bsdam/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan bdun gcu/ de gsum thig le dag byed do// brgyad pa rkang gcig pa ni/ bca' gzhi gnyis pa dang 'dra ba las/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i pus mo'i gong la g.yas pa'i mthil sbyar/ pus mo g.yas la skyed/ lag pa gnyis ka brkyangs te/ 'phar rdeb gsum byed/ de nyid g.yas g.yon go ldog pa'ang lan gsum bya/ dgu pa rkang gnyis ni/ bca' gzhi gnyis pa bzhin las/ rkang lag g.yas pa gnyis mdun du g.yon bskor byas nas/ gyen du cung zad btegs te/ brla g.yas kyi rgyab zur du lag pa sor mo dang bcas pa shad kyis brkyang pa dang*/ rting pa'ang de phyogs su sa la brdab/ g.yon pa'ang de bzhin byed/ 'di'i gzhung las/ (142)brgyad pa dang dgu pa 'di gnyis la thog ma lag pa gcig gis 'khar ba la 'ju ba dang mjug tu gnyis kas 'jus nas ring du 'phar zhing dbyug mchong byed par bshad kyang*/ deng sang lag len mi byed par 'dug

/bcu pa gcu ba ni/ sor mo bsnol bas brang dang mchan khung btsir ba bdun pa dang 'dra rung ba las/ langs pa'i skabs/ mgo dang ltag pa sgyed pa'i ngang nas g.yas g.yon lan gsum gcud/ de rjes rlung bsgyur byas te sa la bsdad nas/ mgo dang ro stod lan gsum gcud/ de nas pus mo btsugs pa'i phyed langs la/ lag pa g.yas pa sngar bzhin/ g.yon pa rgyab nas bskor te dpyi g.yas pa la 'jus pas/ ro stod g.yon du gcud/ de bzhin du go ldog par bya'o// bcu gcig pa bu chung tshul ni/ bsngad la mgo bo bskor zhing mgo lcogs sprug pa lan gsum dang*/ langs nas kyang mgo bo bskor zhing mgo lcogs sprug pa lan gsum rnams bya'o// bcu gnyis pa 'phar ba ni/ rting 'khrab lan gsum gyi mthar/ lag pa khu tshur brkyangs te/ 'phong sar brdab// de 'dra lan gsum bya/ de lnga rlung dang thig le thun mong dag par byed pa'o// bcu gsum pa rtsa dbu ma kha 'byed dang po ni/ skyil krung bcas/ lus bsrangs/ lag pa khu tshur gnyis thad kar brkyang ba las/ g.yon khu tshur nu khar brdeg cing mnan/ g.yas 'phongs tshos g.yas kyi phyogs thad ka la bskum khru gang tsam du brkyang*/ de 'dra ba lan gsum byed/ de nyid go zlog pa'ang lan gsum byed/ 'di la g.yas g.yon bsnol ba zer/ dbu ma kha 'byed gnyis pa ni/ rlung 'khrab byas nas langs/ lag pa brkyangs te pho ba sa la btsugs/ kha mig gdangs/ yan lag bzhi brkyang bskum bya zhing drag tu sprug pa'o// 'di la bsgrad pa'i mtha' zer/ bco lnga pa dbu mar 'jug pa ni/ bca' gzhi dang bstun nas langs// (143)rlung mthur la brdeg cing*/ lag pa brkyangs te nu khar brdeg pa lan gsum bya/ yang lag gnyis khu tshur brla'i zur du brkyangs la/ mthur sel drag tu 'then pa gsum bya/ yang lag pa rgod gshog bzhin brkyangs la rting 'khrab gsum byas nas/ lus drag tu sprug /yang rlung phyir bsal nas kyang drag tu sprug go /bcu drug pa dbu mar 'dren pa ni/

langs te lag pa gnyis bsnol/ khu tshur g.yas g.yon gyis mchan khung dang*/ lag ngar gyis nu ma btsir/ rtsib logs g.yas dgang*/ mgo g.yon du 'khyog pa dang lhan cig rlung g.yas gyen 'then dang*/ de nyid go ldog pas g.yas mthur gnon bya/ g.yon la'ang des rigs 'gre/ de bzhin du ltag pa sgyed la mdun du 'then gnon dang sgur la/ rgyab la'ang 'then gnon bya/ bcu bdun pa dbu mar sdud pa ni/ sngar bzhin langs la/ lag pa bsnol/ lag mthil dpung pa g.yas g.yon la bkab/ pho ba g.yas bskor g.yon bskor gsum/ ro stod g.yas g.yon du gcu/ sked pa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du phar kyog tshur kyog bya zhing 'chun btsal lo// kha 'byed gnyis/ gar gsum zhes so sor bgrang yang chab cig tu 'ong bas kha 'byed gnyis dang*/ 'jug 'dren sdud gsum ste lnga la rdo rje gar gyi 'khrul 'khor zhes so// bco brgyad pa ni nyon mongs sel ba'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ste/ de la nang tshan du phye na brgyad yod/ dang po gti mug sel ba rnam snang gi phyag rgya ni/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya snying gar bcas nas/ mdun du brkyangs la/ g.yas g.yon steng 'og rnams su gcu zhing*/ nu ma dang pho bar brdeg /rgod pa sel ba ni/ skyil krung ngang nas srin lag gnyis 'dud pa'i sor mo gzhan rnams kyis ltag pa'i chu ba nas mnan te ltag pa dgug /ro stod g.yas g.yon du lan gsum drag tu gcu/ lag pa steng (144)du brkyangs te/ spyi bor thal lcag rgyab/ lan gsum/ khra tshag sel ba ni/ lag gnyis pus mo nas blangs te/ bzhag sha brdab cing mdun du brkyangs nas/ don yong grub pa'i phyag rgya bcas pa snying ga dang lte 'og tu brdab/ g.yon pa'i lag ngar bsrang nas gcud do// gnod byed gzir ba ni/ skyil krung ngang nas/ lag pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus dang steng phyogs nas cung zad rgyab la sgyed de/ g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum bskor ba dang lhan cig mig gdangs shing shugs bskyed pa'i lta stangs kyis mig kyang bskor ro// zhe sdang sel ba mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya ni/

skyil krung byas nas dpyad phrag brdab/ sor bcu bsnol bas brang gi dbus rnams bsdams shing*/ gru mo phyir bkyed la g.yas g.yon du lan gsum gsum gcu ba dang*/ lag gnyis sa gnon byas te/ g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du khro bo'i sta stangs kyis blta'o// da rgyal sel ba 'od dpag med kyi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gi ngang nas lag ngar bsrang ba'i mnyam bzhag shugs bskyed/ mnyam gzhag btegs nas pho bar brdeg cing bsdams/ yang lag ngar bsrang ba sogs lan gsum/ de rjes rlung phyir 'bud pa dang lhan cig ha drag po lan gsum brjod/ 'dod chags sel ba ni/ bca' gzhi'i ngang nas rkang pa g.yas g.yon res mos su lan gsum bskor zhing g.yab/ de nas gan rkyal du 'dug ste/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dang*/ g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum byed/ lag pa nam mkhar brkyangs nas zan bsnol ba'i phyag rgya bya/ bde chen 'beb pa che ba ser sna sel ba ni/ skyil krung bcas pa las/ kag gis langs te 'doms 'jal brgyad/ rlung 'khrab bya/ sdigs mdzub byas te g.yas g.yon dang*/ steng 'og dang*/ mdun rgyab tu bskor/ rlung bskyur zhig byas la mchog sbyin brkyang (145)lus sgyed par bya/ 'di la kog langs zer ro// bde ba 'beb pa chung ba ni/ gsum sprug zhes bya ba lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis steng nas 'og tu sprug pa dang*/ ro stod drag tu sprug pa la zer/ de'ang sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bcas nas/ gsum sprug bya/ de nas lag pa g.yas steng dang g.yon 'og tu byas la bsnol/ lag mthil gyen du bstan/ lag mgo g.yon gyi 'og tu g.yas bcug ste/ g.yas pa'i srin lag gis g.yon pa'i srin lag bsdam/ mdun du brkyang bas/ lag ngar gcud la bor ba dang*/ lag stabs de nyid go ldog pas kyang gcud la bor/ re re bzhin shugs 'jug thengs gsum gsum byed/ de nas g.yon khu tshur dpung pa'i thad ka nas mdun gyi g.yon zur la brkyang*/

g.yas kyi khu tshur gyis bshud thebs gsum bya/ g.yas pa la'ang de bzhin du bya/ yang gsum sprugs mthar 'bebs bya'o// phyi ma 'di la gsum sprugs zer te 'gyod pa dang*/ yid mi bde ba dang*/ rnam rtog sel ba yin/ 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams la/ so sor dmigs pa'i gnad re phal cher la yod de/ rtsa ba'i gzhung tshig las shes par bya'o// de ltar na 'di rnams ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ rlung sems dbu mar thim pa dang*/ rtsa mdud grol ba'i man ngag rang lus thabs ldan gtso bor gyur pa/ grol lam mchog sgrub kyi man ngag /lus sbyong bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba yin te/ 'di'i rtsa ba'i gzhung ni/ zhal shes cung zad gab pa dang*/ tshig mang po'i gseb tu 'thor bas sdud mi shes pa dag mang du yod la/ mi mkhas pas sbyar ba'i sdom than thun yod srid na'ang*/ lag len gsal por thon pa med par mngon pas/ 'di'i lag len nub tu nye bar mthong ba'i phyir/ mi nub cing rgyas par bya ba'i don du dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' brgyud la mos pa cung zad thob pa/ tā ra nā thas ma sbas shing gsal bar bkod pa'o// (146)
